legend.as_owner.record: Always the same shape; has_history is false when no rewarded bounty of this owner's has been merged (all counts 0). merged: rewarded bounties GitHub records as merged (GitHub's fact). recorded_paid: the owner says they paid (the owner's word). confirmed_received: the payee says the money arrived (the solver's word). from_solvers: how many different solvers gave those confirmations; one solver can confirm several. owed_now: merged and not recorded paid; oldest_owed_days: the longest of those, in days (the board sets no deadline). says_not_received: recorded paid, but the payee says it has not arrived. median_days_to_record_paid: typical days from merge to the owner's record. Merges where the payee is the poster or has push access to the repository are not counted.
legend.not_counted: Merged rewarded bounties left out of the record because the payee was the poster or had push access.
legend.accepts_payment_by: Methods this person chose to show everyone. Methods marked "only an owner who owes me" are counted, never listed.
